name: James Tedisco

sponsored.t: Enacts Joycelynn's Law
sponsored.sum: Establishes the offenses of aggravated endangering the welfare of a child and aggravated endangering the welfare of a child resulting in death.

sponsored.t: Authorizes Kurt Nolan to receive certain credit under sections 384-d and 384-e of the retirement and social security law
sponsored.sum: Authorizes Kurt Nolan to receive certain credit under sections 384-d and 384-e of the retirement and social security law for prior employment with the New York state university police.

sponsored.t: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to Assembly Member Bobby D'Andrea
sponsored.sum: Dedicates all that portion of the state highway system constituting bridge number 1007069, located on Union Avenue, state route 9P, crossing interstate 87 in the city of Saratoga Springs, county of Saratoga, to Assembly Member Bobby D'Andrea.

sponsored.t: Relates to method of collection of charges by the town of Wilton water and sewer authority
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the town of Wilton water and sewer authority to collect unpaid water bills through tax collections.
sponsored.fis: None for the state, will allow the town of Wilton to collect unpaid water bills in an efficient and timely manner.

sponsored.t: Enacts Jacobe's Law
sponsored.sum: Enacts Jacobe's Law requiring school administrators to contact the parents or guardians of students when bullying or harassment has occurred.

sponsored.t: Extends the duration of certain brownfield redevelopment and remediation tax credits for certain sites
sponsored.sum: Extends the duration of certain brownfield redevelopment and remediation tax credits for 125 Bath Street within the village of Ballston Spa, Saratoga county.

sponsored.t: Grants retroactive membership with Tier IV status in the New York state and local employees' retirement system to William Kerr
sponsored.sum: Grants retroactive membership with Tier IV status in the New York state and local employees' retirement system to William Kerr.

sponsored.t: Waives metered parking fees for certain vehicles displaying a handicapped permit or with handicapped plates
sponsored.sum: Waives metered parking fees for certain vehicles displaying a handicapped permit or with handicapped plates.

sponsored.t: Relates to voting by the senate on nominations of the governor
sponsored.sum: Requires that each appointment to an office by the governor by and with the advice and consent of the senate shall be voted on individually by the senate; provides that nominations may not be considered, confirmed or rejected as a slate or group; requires that all votes be conducted with a roll call vote with each senator's vote noted on the record.

sponsored.t: Provides for recall of a statewide elective officer
sponsored.sum: Provides for recall of a statewide elective officer; empowers the citizens with the ability to remove elective officers.
sponsored.fis: Additional administrative costs to be paid by the State General Fund.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the passage of bills by the legislature between the hours of midnight and eight o'clock a.m. unless two-thirds of the legislature is present and requires two-thirds approval for messages of necessity
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the passage of bills by the legislature between the hours of midnight and eight o'clock a.m. unless 2/3 of the legislature is present; requires two-thirds approval for messages of necessity.

sponsored.t: Provides for the recall power of the electors to remove an elective officer
sponsored.sum: Provides for the recall power of the electors to remove an elective officer.

sponsored.t: Requires that any bill which provides revenue to the state in a non-recurring manner shall pass by a two-thirds majority in order to become law
sponsored.sum: Requires that any bill which provides revenue to the state in a non-recurring manner shall pass by a two-thirds majority in order to become law.

sponsored.t: Prohibits certain borrowing arrangements
sponsored.sum: Prohibits certain borrowing arrangements; relates to the authorization for the contracting of debt; relates to the manner by which payments are appropriated and paid.
sponsored.fis: This bill will limit the amount of debt issued by the State, and will result in significant debt service savings.

sponsored.t: Allows only citizens to vote at elections
sponsored.sum: Allows only citizens to vote at elections.

sponsored.t: Provides for the governor to fill a vacancy for the offices of comptroller and attorney-general
sponsored.sum: Provides for the governor to fill a vacancy for the offices of comptroller and attorney-general and for such person to serve until the next general election.
sponsored.fis: Possibly a slight increased administrative cost for the general election but this should be minimized by the fact that other candidates will be on the ballot.

sponsored.t: Relates to special elections of federal officers
sponsored.sum: Incorporates legislative provisions regarding the conduct of special elections to fill vacancies in federal elected offices into the constitution.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "child survivor privacy act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "child survivor privacy act"; provides protections for child victims and child witnesses; restricts information to the public regarding a child witness or child victim's identity or proceeding; defines child witness; provides that whenever practical, the same prosecutor, advocate, and/or social worker shall handle all aspects of a case involving an alleged child victim.

sponsored.t: Expands a certain tax credit for farmers to include the cost of construction of housing for farm workers
sponsored.sum: Expands a certain tax credit for farmers to include the cost of construction of housing for farm workers.

sponsored.t: Relates to barring a person convicted of a hate crime from attending any state public school of higher education
sponsored.sum: Bars a person who is convicted of a hate crime from attending any SUNY or CUNY institution; provides for the expulsion of a student who is convicted of hate crimes; provides for reinstatement of such student if the conviction is subsequently overturned.

sponsored.t: Increases the enhanced STAR property tax deduction for tax for final assessment rolls to be completed after two thousand twenty-six and eliminates school taxes for certain persons eighty and older
sponsored.sum: Increases the enhanced STAR property tax deduction for tax for final assessment rolls to be completed after two thousand twenty-six; provides a total exemption from school taxes for certain persons eighty years of age and older.

sponsored.t: Relates to setting bail for defendants who pose a threat to public safety
sponsored.sum: Relates to setting bail for dangerous defendants who pose a threat to public safety; requires a court to make an individualized determination based on the principal's record of a prior felony conviction, failure to appear in court or arrest during the interim period while awaiting a preliminary hearing or trial.

sponsored.t: Establishes a temporary state commission to study and investigate the effects of the COVID-19 pandemic response on deaths in nursing homes; and providing for the repeal of such provisions upon expiration thereof
sponsored.sum: Establishes a temporary state commission to study and investigate the effects of the COVID-19 pandemic response on deaths in nursing homes; provides for the repeal of such provisions upon expiration thereof.

sponsored.t: Requires propositions authorizing creation of a state debt to contain an estimate of the debt service payable and publish an explanation thereof
sponsored.sum: Requires that any ballot proposition creating a state debt shall contain an estimate of the amortization period and the total expected debt service payable thereon until the bonds issued pursuant to such proposition are retired; relates to deposits to the tax stabilization reserve fund; provides that at least 10% of any surplus shall be used to pay down state debt.

sponsored.t: Includes aggravated cemetery desecration in the second degree and aggravated cemetery desecration in the first degree as specified offenses for purposes of hate crimes
sponsored.sum: Includes aggravated cemetery desecration in the second degree and aggravated cemetery desecration in the first degree as specified offenses for purposes of hate crimes.

sponsored.t: Relates to speed limits on state highways
sponsored.sum: Provides that the maximum speed limit on state highways may be established pursuant to an engineering and/or traffic investigation authorized or performed by the department of transportation or the municipality within which the section of state highway subject to such speed limit is located.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring bills with a threshold level of co-sponsorship to be brought to the floor for a vote to be taken thereon
sponsored.sum: Relates to requiring bills with a threshold level of co-sponsorship to be brought to the floor for a vote to be taken thereon.

sponsored.t: Establishes an elderly dental insurance coverage program; appropriation
sponsored.sum: Establishes an elderly dental insurance coverage program; specifies eligibility requirements; specifies penalties for fraud and abuse; appropriates $20,000,000 therefor.
sponsored.fis: Makes an appropriation of $20 million to the Department of Civil Service out of the General Fund for the purposes of carrying out the provisions of this act.

sponsored.t: Relates to the disposition of fetal remains
sponsored.sum: Relates to the disposition of fetal remains.
sponsored.fis: None to the state. Financial burden would fall to the mother who chooses to properly dispose of her baby's remains.

sponsored.t: Exempts from state income taxation the first $250,000 earned by four-year college graduates or the first $150,000 earned by two-year graduates
sponsored.sum: Enacts the graduate outreach assistance law to exempt from state income taxation the first two hundred fifty thousand dollars, with a fifty thousand dollar cap per year, earned by a four-year college graduate and the first one hundred fifty thousand dollars, with a twenty-five thousand dollar cap per year, earned by a two-year college graduate.

sponsored.t: Adds elderly persons to disaster preparedness registries and creates a state emergency assistance database
sponsored.sum: Adds elderly persons to disaster preparedness registries; creates a state emergency assistance database; provides that the disaster preparedness commission shall establish the state emergency assistance database; provides that all records relating to SEAD shall be confidential and the commission shall not be liable for any claim based upon a good faith exercise or performance of duty.

sponsored.t: Relates to providing a tax credit for qualified expenses relating to healthy living
sponsored.sum: Relates to providing a tax credit for qualified expenses relating to healthy living; provides such credit shall equal, up to one thousand dollars, the amount paid by the taxpayer during the taxable year for qualified expenses relating to healthy living.

sponsored.t: Relates to providing additional reimbursement to school districts for expenses incurred for failure to receive timely payments of state aid
sponsored.sum: Relates to providing additional reimbursement to school districts for expenses incurred for failure to receive timely payments of state aid, including expenses relating to interest payments and ancillary expenses incurred as a result of not having received aid in a timely manner.

sponsored.t: Expands the definition of aggravated cruelty to animals to include harm to a companion animal during the commission of a felony
sponsored.sum: Enacts "Kirby and Quigley's Law"; expands the definition of aggravated cruelty to animals to include harm to a companion animal during the commission of a felony.

sponsored.t: Provides that crimes committed against a person on school grounds shall be deemed to be one category higher than the specified crime the person committed
sponsored.sum: Provides that crimes committed against a person on school grounds shall be deemed to be one category higher than the specified crime the person committed; enacts "Suzanne's Law".

sponsored.t: Enacts the "truth in spending act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "truth in spending act"; creates disclosure requirements prior to the allocation of certain funds.

sponsored.t: Relates to providing a tax credit for spay or neuter services
sponsored.sum: Provides a tax credit for spay or neuter services.

sponsored.t: Relates to vulnerable elderly persons
sponsored.sum: Relates to vulnerable elderly or disabled persons; deletes references to caregiver to make any person who endangers the welfare of an elderly or disabled person guilty of provisions of the penal law.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "over-expenditure, under-expenditure, transfer notification (OUT) act" to provide for the use of surplus appropriated funds and over-expenditure approval
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "over-expenditure, under-expenditure, transfer notification (OUT) act" to provide for the use of surplus appropriated funds and over-expenditure approval.

sponsored.t: Requires legislative approval of any increased fees, rental or charges for the use of the thruway
sponsored.sum: Requires legislative approval of any increased fees, rental or charges for the use of the thruway; provides that any shortfalls in revenue resulting from a denied proposal shall be made whole by the general fund.

sponsored.t: Authorizes imposition of life imprisonment without parole sentence for persistent violent felony offenders; repealer
sponsored.sum: Authorizes imposition of life imprisonment without parole sentence for persistent violent felony offenders upon conviction of a violent felony offense when such person has previously been subjected to two or more predicate violent felony convictions.
sponsored.fis: Increased length is incarceration for a certain population of criminals.

sponsored.t: Relates to mandatory reporting of suspected child abuse or maltreatment
sponsored.sum: Relates to mandatory reporting of suspected child abuse or maltreatment at summer day camps; includes college coaches, athletic directors, professors, graduate assistants and college presidents among those required to report such suspected abuse or maltreatment.

sponsored.t: Provides for the posthumous awarding of high school diplomas
sponsored.sum: Directs the board of education or the board of trustees of each school district shall establish a policy and adopt procedures permitting the district to confer a diploma on a student posthumously if, at the time of death, such student had completed the eleventh grade class of a public school in the district and was enrolled or expected to be enrolled in the twelfth grade class within the same public school district the following school year.

sponsored.t: Establishes a tax credit for the cost of veterinary services
sponsored.sum: Establishes a tax credit for the cost of veterinary services up to two thousand dollars per year.
sponsored.fis: This would provide financial incentive for pet owners to get their pets treated at veterinary clinics and hospitals.

sponsored.t: Provides an exemption for drugs and medicines for companion and farm animals
sponsored.sum: Relates to providing an exemption for drugs and medicines for companion and farm animals.

sponsored.t: Establishes a task force on pandemic learning loss in New York state; and provides for the repeal of such provisions upon the expiration thereof
sponsored.sum: Establishes the task force on pandemic learning loss in New York state to assess the impact of remote learning on children's progress in various disciplines; requires a report; provides for the repeal of such provisions upon the expiration thereof.

sponsored.t: Establishes the "Purple Star School Program" to assist military-connected students and to recognize the value of military service and civic responsibility
sponsored.sum: Establishes the "Purple Star School Program" to assist military-connected students and to recognize the value of military service and civic responsibility.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "migrant home rule transfer and transparency act"
sponsored.sum: Prohibits a municipality from relocating migrants from such municipality to another municipality in New York unless and until a resolution authorizing the relocation has been adopted by the governing bodies of both the municipality to which the migrants are to be relocated and the county in which the receiving municipality is located; mandates written notice prior to location; provides for a fine for violations.
sponsored.fis: In the event of a violation, this bill will generate revenue to the state, and upon enactment will prevent financially overburdening locali- ties.

sponsored.t: Exempts lemonade stands operated by persons under sixteen years of age from department of health permitting requirements
sponsored.sum: Exempts lemonade stands operated by persons under sixteen years of age from department of health permitting requirements.

sponsored.t: Relates to implementing a dangerous dog owner alert system
sponsored.sum: Relates to implementing a dangerous dog owner alert system.

sponsored.t: Establishes the New York state commission on out-migration
sponsored.sum: Establishes the New York state commission on out-migration which examines why the state of New York is losing residents and offering recommendations to reverse such trend.

sponsored.t: Relates to providing additional reimbursement to school districts for expenses incurred as a result of an influx of migrant students entering the schools of the districts
sponsored.sum: Relates to providing additional reimbursement to school districts for expenses incurred as a result of an influx of migrant students entering the schools of the districts; directs the governor to submit chapter amendments to the Aid to Localities budget.

sponsored.t: Relates to certain assault crimes which include the aid or encouragement of additional persons
sponsored.sum: Relates to certain assault crimes wherein a person is aided or encouraged to strike the victim in the head and cause unconsciousness.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "prison privilege limitation act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "prison privilege limitation act"; restricts prison privileges, including the wearing of civilian clothing, for certain incarcerated individuals.

sponsored.t: Prohibits a person convicted of violating "Buster's Law" from owning or possessing a companion animal
sponsored.sum: Prohibits a person convicted of "Buster's Law" from owning or possessing a companion animal unless authorized by court order, after appropriate psychiatric or psychological testing.

sponsored.t: Makes the failure to provide food, water or appropriate shelter to a companion animal left outside a felony
sponsored.sum: Makes the failure to provide food, water or appropriate shelter to a companion animal (dogs and cats) left outside a felony punishable by a fine of not more than $5,000, or imprisonment for not more than 2 years, or by both such fine and imprisonment.
sponsored.fis: None, and strict enforcement of penalties and fines may create addi- tional revenues for municipalities.

sponsored.t: Establishes the bystander protection act
sponsored.sum: Establishes the bystander protection act which increases the punishment for an offense when a member of the public is harmed, but the intended target is a public official.

sponsored.t: Authorizes a distinctive "guardians for schools" license plate; and establishes the guardians for schools fund
sponsored.sum: Authorizes a distinctive "guardians for schools" license plate; establishes the guardians for schools fund.

sponsored.t: Requires the prior approval of the appropriate legislative committees required of agency rules and regulations
sponsored.sum: Requires state agencies to submit proposed rules and regulations intended to implement legislation to the appropriate committee of the legislature for approval; provides that no such rule or regulation shall take effect unless it has been approved by a majority vote of such legislative committee.

sponsored.t: Repeals article 26 of the tax law known as the estate tax
sponsored.sum: Repeals the estate tax.
sponsored.fis: Decrease of $577.2 million in State revenues, although mitigated by an increase in economic activity and a more competitive business climate.

sponsored.t: Requires the forfeiture by state officers or local officers of STAR exemption eligibility upon conviction of a felony related to public employment
sponsored.sum: Requires the forfeiture by state officers or local officers of STAR exemption eligibility upon conviction of a felony related to public employment.
sponsored.fis: Savings to the State to the extent that the State will not have to disburse STAR rebate checks to certain convicted felons.

sponsored.t: Increases certain penalties for violating the prohibition of animal fighting and for aggravated cruelty to animals
sponsored.sum: Increases certain penalties for violating the prohibition of animal fighting and for aggravated cruelty to animals; requires a psychiatric evaluation for defendants convicted of aggravated cruelty to animals.

sponsored.t: Relates to ensuring privacy protections for all emergency personnel present at a crime scene
sponsored.sum: Ensures privacy protections for all emergency personnel present at a crime scene including ambulance services or advanced life support first response services, certified first responders, firefighters, emergency medical technicians or advanced emergency medical technicians, who are employed by or enrolled members of any such service.

sponsored.t: Relates to grants to local governments for the reduction of paperwork
sponsored.sum: Establishes competitive paperwork reduction project grants; provides that such grants may be included for calculations of government efficiency plans.

sponsored.t: Imposes additional penalties upon persons convicted of animal abuse
sponsored.sum: Requires unsealing of court records of youthful offenders convicted of animal abuse offense; provides that such persons undergo a psychiatric evaluation and treatment where necessary.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "chronic criminal act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "chronic criminal act"; establishes the crime of aggravated criminal conduct.

sponsored.t: Establishes the crimes of harassment of a law enforcement officer or a member of the officer's family in the first degree and second degree
sponsored.sum: Establishes the crimes of harassment of a law enforcement officer or a member of the officer's family in the first degree and second degree.

sponsored.t: Requires legislative approval of increases in utility charges
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "utility ratepayer protection act"; requires legislative approval of increases in utility charges.

sponsored.t: Establishes the bullet-proof vests for officers fund
sponsored.sum: Establishes the bullet-proof vests for officers fund.

sponsored.t: Requires equal distribution of legislative staff and resources
sponsored.sum: Requires an equal distribution of legislative staff and appropriations to be made among all members of the legislature; provides for additional funds and staff for members in special capacities as long as such additional staff does not deal with constituent services.

sponsored.t: Relates to the failure to produce records in response to a FOIL request; and criminalizes the failure to comply with the freedom of information law
sponsored.sum: Relates to the failure to produce records in response to a FOIL request; criminalizes the failure to comply with the freedom of information law.
sponsored.fis: Savings to the state by mandating legal fees and fines not be paid with public funds.

sponsored.t: Relates to eligibility to assume office for certain elected officials owing past-due tax liabilities
sponsored.sum: Relates to eligibility to assume office for certain elected officials owing past-due tax liabilities.

sponsored.t: Limits ownership or possession of companion animals by "Buster's Law" violators
sponsored.sum: Limits ownership or possession of companion animals by "Buster's Law" violators; adds definition of equine companion while taking horses out of farm animal definition.

sponsored.t: Requires each violator of "Buster's Law" to register with the division of criminal justice services
sponsored.sum: Requires each violator of "Buster's Law" to register the violator's name and address with the division of criminal justice services; makes the registration available to the public, law enforcement entities, district attorneys, humane societies, societies for the prevention of cruelty to animals, dog or cat protective associations, animal control officers, breeders of animals, animal rescues and pet stores.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the New York Department of State from issuing a certificate of dissolution and filing a judgment or final order of dissolution for the pension fund for employees of the former St. Clare's Hospital
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the New York Department of State from issuing a certificate of dissolution and filing a judgment or final order of dissolution for the pension fund for employees of the former St. Clare's Hospital in the city of Schenectady, county of Schenectady, until an investigation and/or audit by the New York State Department of Health, the New York State Attorney General or the New York State Comptroller has been conducted to ascertain whether there was any impropriety in the handling and management of funds in such pension plan.

sponsored.t: Requires propositions authorizing creation of a state debt to contain an estimate of the debt service payable and publish an explanation thereof
sponsored.sum: Requires that any ballot proposition creating a state debt shall contain an estimate of the amortization period and the total expected debt service payable thereon until the bonds issued pursuant to such proposition are retired.

sponsored.t: Prohibits sex offenders who are on parole and in civil confinement from voting in certain elections
sponsored.sum: Prohibits sex offenders who are on parole and in civil confinement from voting in certain elections.

sponsored.t: Requires police officers to attend annual diversity training seminars
sponsored.sum: Requires police officers to attend annual diversity training seminars.

sponsored.t: Elevates killing a police work dog or police work horse from being a class E felony to a class D felony
sponsored.sum: Elevates the offense of killing a police work dog or police work horse from being a class E felony to a class D felony; establishes the class E felony of injuring a police work dog or police work horse for intentionally causing serious physical injury to a police work dog or police work horse while such dog or horse is performing its duties under the supervision of a police officer.

sponsored.t: Relates to the issuance of distinctive license plates to volunteer firefighters
sponsored.sum: Eliminates the registration fees charged for the issuance of volunteer firefighter distinctive license plates.

sponsored.t: Directs the New York thruway authority to develop and implement a toll discount program waiving additional costs for tolls related to travel on the New York state thruway for certain individuals
sponsored.sum: Directs the New York thruway authority to develop and implement a toll discount program waiving additional costs for tolls related to travel on the New York state thruway for certain individuals who do not maintain an E-Z Pass account.

sponsored.t: Requires the estimated cost of mandated expenditures and appropriations within the body of the bill
sponsored.sum: Requires the estimated cost of mandated expenditures and appropriations within the body of the bill.
sponsored.fis: None directly associated with enacting this bill. However, the State and local governments will benefit immensely by knowing the fiscal impact of legislation.

sponsored.t: Authorizes certain persons to possess and administer epinephrine by use of an epinephrine auto-injector device upon completion of appropriate training; requires the department of health to establish a registry
sponsored.sum: Authorizes certain persons to possess and administer epinephrine by use of an epinephrine auto-injector device upon completion of appropriate training; requires the department of health to establish a registry of the names of lay persons trained in the use of an epinephrine auto-injector device.

sponsored.t: Provides for the viewing of footage captured by an interior school bus camera in certain circumstances
sponsored.sum: Provides for the viewing of photo or video footage captured by a camera installed inside a school bus, by a parent or guardian of a pupil, when such parent, guardian or pupil reports any incident of physical harm, harassment, intimidation or bullying occurring against the pupil while such pupil travelled on such school bus.

sponsored.t: Requires legislative approval for the closure of correctional facilities and institutions
sponsored.sum: Requires legislative approval for the closure of correctional facilities and institutions.

sponsored.t: Relates to aggravated neglect of a companion animal
sponsored.sum: Relates to aggravated neglect of a companion animal.

sponsored.t: Requires state agencies to make available all public documents in a digital format on their website
sponsored.ls: New York State Printing and Public Documents Law
sponsored.sum: Requires state agencies to make available all public documents in a digital format on their website in a manner that allows such documents to be printed; provides that no document required by law to remain confidential shall be deemed a public document.

sponsored.t: Establishes a rental assistance loan-to-grant program to assist landlords due to the COVID-19 pandemic
sponsored.sum: Establishes a rental assistance loan-to-grant program to assist landlords of small rental properties who have lost rental income due to the inability of the landlords' tenants to pay rent during the COVID-19 state disaster emergency; provides for the repeal of such provisions upon the expiration thereof.

sponsored.t: Relates to the penalty for the offense of predatory sexual assault against a child
sponsored.sum: Relates to the penalty for the offense of predatory sexual assault against a child; provides for lifetime parole for such felons.

sponsored.t: Establishes limitations on taxes on diesel motor fuel and motor fuel; authorizes certain local laws limiting taxes on motor fuel
sponsored.sum: Provides for a phased decrease of excise taxes and sales taxes and petroleum business taxes on diesel motor fuel and motor fuel when the average price of motor fuel in the state exceeds $2.25 per gallon; authorizes cities having a population of one million or more and counties to adopt local laws limiting taxes on diesel motor fuel and motor fuel.

sponsored.t: Requires that license plates be inspected during vehicle safety inspections and waives fees for the issuance of certain license plates
sponsored.sum: Requires that license plates be inspected during vehicle safety inspections and waives fees for the issuance of certain license plates.

sponsored.t: Relates to making an appropriation for the purpose of establishing and expanding training programs for direct support professionals at boards of cooperative educational services
sponsored.sum: Appropriates $5,550,000 for the purpose of establishing and expanding training programs for direct support professionals at boards of cooperative educational services.

sponsored.t: Prohibits certain COVID-19 mask and face covering mandates by state agencies
sponsored.sum: Prohibits state agencies from promulgating rules, regulations or any form of guidance requiring individuals under the age of eighteen who are not exhibiting COVID-19 related symptoms, as defined by the centers for disease control and prevention, to wear a mask or face covering in a public place or while participating in any recreational or organized sporting activity.

sponsored.t: Relates to an investigation of the health department's pandemic response with regard to nursing homes and adult care and assisted living facilities
sponsored.sum: Directs the commissioner of health to conduct an investigation of the department's performance, compliance and enforcement of applicable state laws, rules, regulations, and directives or executive orders, with respect to mitigating the impact of COVID-19 in nursing homes, adult care facilities, and assisted living residences, and to propose a pandemic response plan for future disease outbreaks.

sponsored.t: Establishes a limitation on financial services assessments and appropriation suballocations
sponsored.sum: Establishes a limitation on financial services assessments and appropriation suballocations; requires that money obtained from assessments shall only be used to defray operating expenses of the department of financial services.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the dissolution and discontinuance by the town of Ballston, in the county of Saratoga, of the Jenkins Park District
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the dissolution and discontinuance by the town of Ballston, in the county of Saratoga, of the Jenkins Park District.

sponsored.t: Increases the penalties for owners of dangerous dogs
sponsored.sum: Increases the penalties for owners of dangerous dogs and subjects certain dangerous dog owners to further investigation.

sponsored.t: Relates to aggravated cruelty to animals in the presence of a child
sponsored.sum: Relates to aggravated cruelty to animals in the presence of a child; increases the potential term of imprisonment from two to four years when such crime is committed in the presence of a child; defines presence of a child.

sponsored.t: Increases the number of county court judges in Saratoga county
sponsored.sum: Increases the number of county court judges in Saratoga county by one justice.

sponsored.t: Repeals certain provisions of the criminal procedure law, judiciary law and the executive law and makes conforming changes thereto; repealer
sponsored.sum: Provides judges with more discretion regarding securing orders and limiting the lengths of certain orders; establishes new criminal discovery rules.

sponsored.t: Relates to adjudications and owner liability for a violation of traffic-control signal indications in the city of Schenectady
sponsored.sum: Relates to adjudications and owner liability for a violation of traffic-control signal indications in the city of Schenectady.

sponsored.t: Relates to aggravated cruelty to animals during an incident of domestic violence
sponsored.sum: Authorizes a lengthier prison sentence for a person who commits aggravated cruelty to animals during an incident of domestic violence.

sponsored.t: Relates to owner liability for failure of an operator to comply with stop signs in the village of Round Lake, county of Saratoga
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the village of Round Lake, county of Saratoga to establish a demonstration program imposing monetary liability on the owner of a vehicle for failure of an operator thereof to stop for a stop sign in such village.

sponsored.t: Relates to allowing victim impact statements to be submitted at parole revocation hearings
sponsored.sum: Allows victim impact statements to be submitted at parole revocation hearings.

sponsored.t: Provides distinctive license plates for members of the Seabee Veterans of America
sponsored.sum: Provides for distinctive license plates for members of the Seabee Veterans of America.

sponsored.t: Relates to regulating the operation of animal boarding kennels
sponsored.sum: Provides for the licensing, inspection and regulation of animal boarding kennels; authorizes the department of agriculture and markets to license, inspect and regulate animal boarding kennels.

sponsored.t: Designates the colors blue and yellow as the official colors of the state of New York
sponsored.sum: Designates the colors blue and yellow as the official colors of the state of New York.

sponsored.t: Establishes a school speed zone camera demonstration program in the city of Schenectady
sponsored.sum: Establishes a school speed zone camera demonstration program in the city of Schenectady; repeals authorization of program December 31, 2030.

sponsored.t: Relates to hotel and motel taxes in Saratoga county and the city of Saratoga Springs
sponsored.sum: Relates to hotel and motel taxes in Saratoga county and the city of Saratoga Springs; increases the allowable amount of tax imposed by the county; removes exemptions for properties having less than 4 units; relates to the disposition of tax revenues collected; eliminates an advisory committee.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the commissioner of general services to transfer and convey certain lands in the town of Wilton, county of Saratoga, to the Veterans and Community Housing Coalition
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the commissioner of general services to transfer and convey certain lands in the town of Wilton, county of Saratoga, to the Veterans and Community Housing Coalition.

sponsored.t: Requires that all victim impact statements in New York state be video recorded; requires that the members of the parole board review all relevant victim impact statements prior to the conduct of a parole hearing
sponsored.sum: Allows victim impact statements in New York state be video recorded; requires that the members of the parole board and all presiding commissioners for such hearing review all relevant victim impact statements prior to the conduct of a parole hearing and to sign a written attestation confirming that they have done so.

sponsored.t: Requiring a petition in a summary proceeding to recover possession of real property in Schenectady to allege proof of compliance with local laws requiring rental residential property registration and licensure
sponsored.ls: Real Property Actions and Proceedings Law
sponsored.sum: Requires a petition in a summary proceeding to recover possession of real property in the city of Schenectady to allege proof of compliance with local laws requiring rental residential property registration and licensure.
